EDRM 423.description: Development of assessments for different content areas and grade levels, and processes for making decisions based on assessment results.
EDRM 423.subject: EDRM
EDRM 423.title: Introduction to Classroom Assessment

EDRM 520.description: The construction and use of teacher-made tests; descriptive statistics, measurement error, norms, and interpretation of scores; types of standardized instruments for use in elementary and secondary schools.
EDRM 520.subject: EDRM
EDRM 520.title: Introduction to Testing and Evaluation

EDRM 700.description: Concepts and methods of conducting research in education. Admission to graduate standing.
EDRM 700.subject: EDRM
EDRM 700.title: Introduction to Research in Education

EDRM 705.description: Introduction to methods of statistical inference in educational research, including additional topics in hypothesis testing, linear statistical models, and non-parametric analyses.
EDRM 705.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 700.
EDRM 705.subject: EDRM
EDRM 705.title: Applied Educational Statistics I

EDRM 706.description: Advanced methods of statistical inference used in educational research, including additional topics in differences between groups, linear and nonlinear statistical models, and non-parametric analyses.
EDRM 706.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 705 or another introduction to applied statistics course.
EDRM 706.subject: EDRM
EDRM 706.title: Applied Educational Statistics II

EDRM 710.description: Introductory course in statistics for graduate students in education and the other social sciences. Central tendency and variability, normal distribution, simple correlation and regression, z and t tests for one and two samples, and the chi-square test. Use of statistical software.
EDRM 710.subject: EDRM
EDRM 710.title: Educational Statistics I

EDRM 711.description: Continuation of Educational Statistics I. Inference for one and two samples, factorial designs, repeated measures designs, and multiple regression. Use of statistical software.
EDRM 711.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 710.
EDRM 711.subject: EDRM
EDRM 711.title: Educational Statistics II

EDRM 712.description: Applied nonparametric statistics in education and the social sciences. Distribution-free inference for repeated measures and factorial designs; logistic regression and log-linear analysis. Use of statistical software.
EDRM 712.subject: EDRM
EDRM 712.title: Nonparametric Statistics

EDRM 715.description: The study and practice of mixed methods research. The integration of qualitative and quantitative approaches and methods in research practices. Emphasis on educational research and settings with consideration of other social science fields as needed.
EDRM 715.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: An initial course in or experience with quantitative research (example - EDRM 705 or EDRM 710) and qualitative research (example - EDFI 731).
EDRM 715.subject: EDRM
EDRM 715.title: Mixed Methods Research

EDRM 718.description: Advanced use of available statistical packages in educational research. Content varies; topics and credit announced in advance. May be repeated for up to six hours of credit. May be repeated for up to 6 hours of credit.
EDRM 718.subject: EDRM
EDRM 718.title: Research and the Statistical Packages

EDRM 720.description: The history of educational and psychological measurement. Consideration of concepts such as validity and reliability of educational and psychological measures and the rationale of the development and use of instruments for educational purposes.
EDRM 720.subject: EDRM
EDRM 720.title: Educational Measurement

EDRM 721.description: The rationale, construction, use, and appraisal of achievement tests as tools of educational evaluation and research.
EDRM 721.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDRM 710 and EDRM 720 or equivalent.
EDRM 721.subject: EDRM
EDRM 721.title: Constructing Cognitive Instruments

EDRM 722.description: Consideration and the construction of educational and psychological tests and measurement instruments.
EDRM 722.subject: EDRM
EDRM 722.title: Constructing Non-Cognitive Instruments

EDRM 723.description: Emphasis in the linkages between curriculum, instruction, and assessment, and the development of assessments for learning outcomes. Methods include observations, interviewing, performance assessments, portfolios, and classroom tests.
EDRM 723.subject: EDRM
EDRM 723.title: Classroom Assessment Methods

EDRM 724.description: Topics in surveys: developing the purpose and framework of surveys, item writing, questionnaire design, sampling, administration, analysis of data, and presentation of results.
EDRM 724.subject: EDRM
EDRM 724.title: Survey Design and Analysis

EDRM 728.description: Statistical techniques and theoretical concepts involved in educational and psychological measurement. Analysis and interpretation of test data, equating of equivalent forms, latent trait theories and models, multiple matrix sampling, and issues related to criterion-referenced testing.
EDRM 728.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in EDRM 710.
EDRM 728.subject: EDRM
EDRM 728.title: Technical Aspects of Tests and Measurements

EDRM 736.description: Methods of designing and implementing evaluations of social and educational programs.
EDRM 736.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 700 and EDRM 710.
EDRM 736.subject: EDRM
EDRM 736.title: Program Evaluation

EDRM 737.description: Supervised research experience in a school, state agency, department or bureau of the University, or cooperating institution.
EDRM 737.subject: EDRM
EDRM 737.title: Internship in Research

EDRM 789.description: Theories and applications of covariance structure modeling, including reliability analysis, confirmatory factor analysis, and path analysis with observed and latent variables.
EDRM 789.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDRM 711 or equivalent and EDRM 721 or equivalent.
EDRM 789.subject: EDRM
EDRM 789.title: Principles and Applications of Structural Equation Modeling

EDRM 800.description: Analysis of grant and contract functions in government agencies; proposal writing; legal and fiscal requirements of grants administration.
EDRM 800.subject: EDRM
EDRM 800.title: Grants Administration

EDRM 801.description: Concepts and application of designing research in education.
EDRM 801.subject: EDRM
EDRM 801.title: Principles and Applications of Educational Research

EDRM 810.description: Emphasis on the development of an understanding of the role of inferential statistics in educational experimentation, a working knowledge of the common tests in statistical analysis, and the student’s ability to design and execute experiments involving application of the statistical tests.
EDRM 810.subject: EDRM
EDRM 810.title: Design and Analysis of Experiments

EDRM 812.description: Advanced quantitative methods course in multilevel data analysis. Covers theoretical grounding, applications in the social sciences, and model building.
EDRM 812.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 711.
EDRM 812.subject: EDRM
EDRM 812.title: Hierarchical Linear Modeling

EDRM 816.description: Advanced statistical applications including partial and multiple correlational methods, multiple regression, multivariate analysis of variance, discriminant analysis, and canonical correlation. Use of statistical software.
EDRM 816.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in EDRM 711.
EDRM 816.subject: EDRM
EDRM 816.title: Correlational and Multivariate Methods

EDRM 828.description: Statistical models for item response theory, Rasch and other models for binary and polytomous data, and applications. Use of statistical software.
EDRM 828.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: EDRM 711 or PSYC 710 or STAT 701 or STAT 704.
EDRM 828.subject: EDRM
EDRM 828.title: Item Response Theory

EDRM 840.description: Theory, methodology and practice of qualitative research in educational settings. Students will conduct research in applied settings using qualitative data collection methods including observation, interviews, focus groups, and document analysis.
EDRM 840.subject: EDRM
EDRM 840.title: Advanced Qualitative Inquiry in Education

EDRM 842.description: Examination of biography as a form of educational research and scholarship.
EDRM 842.subject: EDRM
EDRM 842.title: Educational Biography

EDRM 878.description: Theoretical and empirical issues in qualitative and/or quantitative methods in educational research. Content varies; topics and credit announced in advance. May be repeated for up to 12 hours of credit.
EDRM 878.subject: EDRM
EDRM 878.title: Seminar in Research Techniques

EDRM 889.description: Study of advanced concepts, principles, techniques, and issues in structural equation modeling (SEM) and the latent variable framework.
EDRM 889.subject: EDRM
EDRM 889.title: Advanced Principles and Application of Latent Variable Modeling

EDRM 897.description: Topics involved with major issues in the planning and conducting of significant research in education. Several faculty members participate; a forum is provided in which candidates may present for analysis original research designs primarily related to their dissertations.
EDRM 897.subject: EDRM
EDRM 897.title: Dissertation Seminar in Education
